# Machine Gun Spray Foam & Concrete Lifting, LLC

> Veteran-owned spray foam insulation, SPF roofing, protective coatings and concrete lifting based in Glendive, MT, serving Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota and Wyoming. BPI-certified. Call or text 406-939-8301.

Machine Gun Spray Foam & Concrete Lifting is a veteran-owned contractor serving the Northern Plains (MT, ND, SD, WY) from Glendive, Montana. Core work: closed- and open-cell spray foam insulation, seamless spray-foam (SPF) roofing and roof coatings, protective coatings, concrete lifting/leveling, and polyurethane soil/seawall stabilization and void fill. $0-down financing is available through Hearth.

- Phone / text: 406-939-8301 (secondary: 605-349-2884)
- Location: 2402 N Anderson Ave, Glendive, MT 59330
- Service area: Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, Wyoming
- Website: https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/

## Services

- [Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spray-foam-insulation): Closed- & open-cell spray foam insulation for homes, shops, barns & metal buildings across MT, ND, SD & WY. Veteran-owned, BPI-certified.
- [SPF Roofing & Roof Coatings](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spf-roofing): Seamless spray-foam (SPF) roofing & coatings for commercial, shop, ag & metal roofs across MT, ND, SD & WY. Stops leaks, recoatable.
- [Protective & Roof Coatings](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/coatings): Silicone & acrylic roof and protective coatings for metal, flat & foam roofs. Seals seams, reflective, recoatable.
- [Concrete Lifting & Leveling](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/concrete): Sinking driveway, patio, garage or shop slab? We lift & level concrete for a fraction of the cost of tear-out & replacement. Free assessment.
- [Soil Stabilization & Deep Foam Injection](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/soil-stabilization): Polyurethane soil stabilization for slabs, foundations & roads — supports weak soils, fills voids, controls settlement.
- [Seawall & Shoreline Wall Stabilization](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/seawall-stabilization): Polyurethane injection to stabilize seawalls & retaining walls — fills voids, seals water intrusion, stops soil loss. Non-invasive.
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation & Insulation](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/crawl-space-encapsulation): Vapor barrier & closed-cell foam that stop ground moisture, cold floors & musty air.
- [Pole Barn & Post-Frame Insulation](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/pole-barn-insulation): Closed-cell spray foam for pole barns & post-frame buildings — stops condensation, holds heat.
- [Metal Building & Steel Shop Insulation](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/metal-building-insulation): Closed-cell spray foam for metal buildings, steel shops & Quonsets — stops condensation, holds heat.
- [Attic Spray Foam Insulation](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/attic-insulation): Attic spray foam insulation that air-seals the biggest heat-loss path in your building.
- [Ice Dam Prevention with Spray Foam](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/ice-dam-prevention): Air-seal & insulate the attic so the roof deck stays cold — spray foam ice dam prevention.
- [Cool Roofs](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/cool-roofs): A reflective cool-roof coating bounces the sun's heat off your building and eases the load on your AC.
- [Spray Foam Spec & QA Standard](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spray-foam-spec): Closed-cell SPF spec & QA for GCs, builders & inspectors: R-value by climate zone, thermal/ignition barriers, PPE & blower-door QA.

## Guides & Education

- [Open-Cell vs Closed-Cell Spray Foam](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/types-of-spray-foam): Density, R-value, moisture, and where each fits — which one your job needs.
- [Spray Foam & the Building Envelope](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/building-envelope): How spray foam ties insulation and the air/vapor barrier together in one pass.
- [Does Spray Foam Strengthen Walls?](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spray-foam-strengthens-walls): Closed-cell spray foam adds racking stiffness to walls while it air-seals and insulates.
- [SPF Roof Benefits](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spf-roof-benefits): Why a spray foam roof wins — seamless, installs over most existing roofs, adds insulation, reflective top coat.
- [SPF Roof Coatings](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/spf-roof-coatings): How an elastomeric or silicone top coat seals your foam roof from UV and moisture.
- [Seamless SPF Roofing Systems](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/seamless-spf-roofing): Fully-adhered, seamless spray foam roofing — no seams, fasteners or flashing joints for water to find.
- [Sustainable SPF Roofing](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/sustainable-spf-roofing): A spray foam roof can last decades with maintenance, saves energy, and usually installs over your old roof.
- [Wind Uplift Resistance](https://www.machinegunsprayfoam.com/wind-uplift-resistance): Spray foam roofing resists wind uplift — fully adhered, seamless, no weak fastener points. Built for Northern Plains wind.
